answer: An attacker running 104 aliases thus needs 132 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in trellis, expire in thread, and anchor lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 16 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2185 identities would post 2907 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
